name: Italy

flag.description: Three equal vertical stripes of green, white and red from the hoist.
flag.symbolism: The tricolour was inspired by the French flag; green, white and red are popularly said to represent hope, faith and charity.

hook: Italy reads like a pizza margherita from the flagpole: basil, mozzarella, tomato; Ireland ends in orange, and Mexico adds an eagle.
trivia: It was first adopted by the Cispadane Republic in Reggio Emilia on 7 January 1797, now celebrated as Italy's Flag Day.
The royal Savoy coat of arms was removed from the centre when Italy became a republic in 1946.
